verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or data residency in Airweave's hosted service. The only related item is the option to self-host locally on macOS, Linux or WSL. That is a different deployment feature, not a residency control, so under the partial-credit boundary it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
